notes.en: The drawing prioritises legibility over anatomical refinement. A solid gold base carries the dual-pose clearly — four arms and four legs are unambiguous at every size down to 16px, and the circle-and-square geometry is present without overwhelming the figure. The face avoids the smiley-face failure mode with almond eyes and a neutral closed mouth, though the head reads as slightly round and simplified rather than sculpted. The main weakness is the leg area: the together-legs and spread-legs paths overlap in a way that creates flat board-like limbs rather than tapered anatomical forms, and the transition between poses at the groin lacks the crispness of a hand-drawn study. The horizontal arms end in readable hand masses but are more cylindrical tubes than articulated wrists and palms. At the low effort level the construction geometry and tiered ink detail are present and functional.
